answer: Sybil flood is cheap identities. Mechanism: each agent emits a stake-locked heartbeat pulse every epoch; peer panels mirror the cost and latency fingerprint of that pulse. When a gale of near-clone fingerprints arrives, those agents enter quarantine until their stake ages past a 3-epoch cliff or is burned. Cost: locked stake plus signing compute. Verification: digests of pulse+stake-age are checked on-ledger by K peers. Failure: if mirror disagreement exceeds 2/5, rewards freeze for a dispute window and the cheaper clone set loses eligibility.
